description: Defines the QuicTimeWaitListManager class responsible for managing connection IDs in time wait state within the QUIC protocol implementation. Includes structures, enums, and methods for handling packets, connection IDs, and related operations in the context of QUIC's time wait list.

classes.name: TimeWaitConnectionInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a connection in the time wait list, including termination packets, active connection IDs, and SRTT.

classes.name: QuicTimeWaitListManager
classes.description: Manages the list of connection IDs in time wait state, handles packet processing, and manages related operations.

classes.name: QuicTimeWaitListManager::Visitor
classes.description: Interface for callbacks when a connection is added to the time wait list.

classes.name: QuicTimeWaitListManager::QueuedPacket
classes.description: Represents a packet queued for sending in the time wait list manager.

classes.name: QuicTimeWaitListManager::ConnectionIdData
classes.description: Stores data associated with a connection ID in the time wait list, including packet count, timestamp, action, and info.

methods.name: AddConnectionIdToTimeWait
methods.description: Adds a connection ID to the time wait list with specified action and info.

methods.name: IsConnectionIdInTimeWait
methods.description: Checks if a connection ID is currently in the time wait list.

methods.name: ProcessPacket
methods.description: Handles an incoming packet for a connection ID in the time wait list, potentially sending a reset.

methods.name: SendVersionNegotiationPacket
methods.description: Sends a version negotiation packet to a peer.

methods.name: SendPublicReset
methods.description: Creates and sends a public reset packet for a connection ID.
